name: What is the average cost to install a new garage door?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost to install a new garage door?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a new garage door installation varies significantly based on factors such as the door material, style, size, insulation level, and the type of opener chosen. For instance, a basic steel door will be less expensive than a custom wood or full-view glass door. Labor costs are also a factor. While providing a precise average is difficult without specific project details, most installations in the Bay Area can range from $1,000 to $5,000 or more. We offer free estimates to give you an accurate quote for your specific needs.
